descriptionHtml:
• Deeply hydrates and nourishes dry skin with natural goat milk.
  • Soothes and calms sensitive or irritated skin with gentle care.
  • Cleanses without stripping natural moisture, keeping skin soft.
  • Handmade and free from sulfates, parabens, and harsh chemicals.
  • Leaves skin smooth, refreshed, and lightly fragranced with rose.
